text:
takahiro: Hey people-ops — planning to work from Okinawa for ~10 weeks (Sep 4–Nov 12). I have an I-485 pending (green card appl). Quick questions: can I stay on US payroll? How does the WFH stipend proration work? Will my health plan cover care if I need it while abroad? Any state tax nexus issues for CA?

maria (People Ops): Congrats on the trip! Short answers: please fill out the Temporary Remote Request form (link below). Payroll typically stays in US if home base doesn’t change, but we need 30 days notice to flag withholding. WFH stipend is prorated for days you’re out of office. Health: domestic plans often have limited overseas coverage — benefits team can add a travel medical rider for short stays. For tax nexus, depends on residency ties — tagging tax. Please DM your manager approval and exact dates.

ryan (Payroll): @takahiro please include last 4 SSN digits and confirm your payroll home hub (CA). We can keep you on US payroll and continue standard withholding for a short-term stay, but payroll needs the temp remote form + manager note. If anything changes permanenty we’ll do a home base change.

anne (Benefits): FYI most plans exclude routine care overseas. For a 10-week trip we can add our travel medical add-on (one-time fee) — I can run a quote if you want. Also reminder: telehealth still works for many issues. Ping me and I’ll send the quick enrollment link.

tax-team: Short-term remote work abroad can complicate state filing. If you maintain CA home ties (license, voter reg, mailing address) CA residency likely persists and CA tax rules apply. For Japanese tax, sub-90-day stays usually don’t create local filing obligations but context matters (employer presence, clients, income source). We recommend our tax advisor for specifics.

people-ops-bot: Temporary Remote Request created: https://redwood.example/forms/temp-remote-2390012345 — attach manager approval and travel itinerary.

takahiro: Thanks — manager approved and I uploaded the signed form + dates. One more: will my equity vesting or benefits accruals be impacted by a short trip? I’m keeping home base as CA.

maria (People Ops): Good Q — vesting unaffected while you’re on approved temporary remote. Benefits accruals (PTO, etc.) continue as normal. If you change home base permanently we’ll update payroll and benefits accordingly.

legal: Quick note from legal — we’re not immigration counsel. Tourist entry into Japan doesn’t equal work authorization under local law; short remote work is a grey area. If you’ll be engaging with Japanese clients or doing paid local activities, contact Legal before you travel. For personal remote work while on vacation/visit, company-level risk is low but not zero.

ryan (Payroll): Confirmed we’ll maintain US payroll withholding and schedule prorated stipend on next pay cycle. Expect the stipend proration line item on your paystub; reach out if it doesn’t show up.

takahiro: Perfect — appreciate everyone. I’ll take the travel add-on quote and confirm visa status with Legal. Excited for Okinawa :sun_with_face:

maria (People Ops): Enjoy! If you hit any issues while there DM People Ops.
